9 MR. KNEEDLER: Mr. Chief Justice, and may it

18 the APA which authorizes a court to compel agency action
19 unlawfully withheld or unreasonably delayed.

21 text of 706(1) which is limited to compelling agency
22 action, not ongoing agency conduct. It is contrary to the
23 roots of 706(1) in mandamus, which has historically been
24 limited to the performance -- compelling the performance
25 of what this Court termed in its seminal Kendall decision
